I am using git on Linux and recently it has started to hang indefinitely on Cloning into... when running git clone over HTTPS. Things I've tested: Switching DNS I have tried using different DNS servers such as cloudflare 1.1.1.1 , google 8.8.8.8 and Quad9 4.4.4.4 but it still doesn't work. This is the output of running host github.com using the cloudflare DNS: github.com has address 20.26.156.215 github.com mail is handled by 0 github-com.mail.protection.outlook.com. Setting credential provider to generic Another stack overflow post answer suggests setting credential.provider to generic but that didn't work Checking /etc/gitconfig This is the output of running cat /etc/gitconfig [safe] directory = /var/db/repos/steam-overlay directory = /var/db/repos/guru directory = /var/db/repos/gentoo-zh directory = /var/db/repos/chiron-overlay directory = /var/db/repos/gentoo directory = /var/db/repos/hyproverlay directory = /var/db/repos/another-brave-overlay directory = /var/db/repos/librewolf directory = /usr/local/portage/brother-overlay directory = /var/db/repos/proaudio-gentoo directory = /var/db/repos/BetaRays [http] version = HTTP/1.1 ipresolve = ipv4 Running git clone with verbose logs: This is the output of running GIT_TRACE=1 GIT_TRANSFER_TRACE=1 GIT_CURL_VERBOSE=1 git clone https://github.com/gentoo-mirror/gentoo.git 21:46:43.287860 ../git-2.56.0/git.c:506 trace: built-in: git clone https://github.com/gentoo-mirror/gentoo.git Cloning into 'gentoo'... 21:46:43.288989 ../git-2.56.0/run-command.c:673trace: run_command: git remote-https origin https://github.com/gentoo-mirror/gentoo.git 21:46:43.288994 ../git-2.56.0/run-command.c:765trace: start_command: /usr/libexec/git-core/git remote-https origin https://github.com/gentoo-mirror/gentoo.git 21:46:43.289499 ../git-2.56.0/git.c:815 trace: exec: git-remote-https origin https://github.com/gentoo-mirror/gentoo.git 21:46:43.289516 ../git-2.56.0/run-command.c:673trace: run_command: git-remote-https origin https://github.com/gentoo-mirror/gentoo.git 21:46:43.289520 ../git-2.56.0/run-command.c:765trace: start_command: /usr/libexec/git-core/git-remote-https origin https://github.com/gentoo-mirror/gentoo.git 21:46:43.291486 ../git-2.56.0/http.c:994== Info: Could not find host github.com in the .netrc file; using defaults ^C⏎ Here it hangs after the .netrc info log.
